text: The split preserves58existing composition test entries and their per-test settings across six registered manifests. Shared head, preferences and fixture globs stay the same, but the DEFAULT Linux32-bit debug skip condition is removed. Keep that declarative eligibility change separate from the file split; neither proves the listed tests pass or that process/leak isolation improved. The alphabetical-neighbor comment is scoped to this numbered composition family. Exact Git blobs show no listed JavaScript test body changed, and no test body was studied or run.
title: The composition manifest split also removes one blanket platform skip
